structured.reason: The "Built for Beginners" section implicitly responds to the reviewers' complaints about difficulty and unclear instructions. "Basic instructions come in the packaging to help you get started" hedges about the instructions, which reviewers called "TOTALLY WORTHLESS" and "awfully small." "Practice a few styles and build your skills at your own pace" concedes a learning curve, the same implication as "after a short learning curve," and reads as defensive framing of the "too difficult" and "too complicated" reviews. The rest of the description (features, color matching, the kit contents, value) is plain positive or neutral. The failure is borderline because no weakness is stated outright, but the beginner section clearly alludes to a known complaint.
